verdict.rationale: Digits ships a substantial first-party Connect API: ledger reads, financial statements, chart of accounts, batch transaction sync, webhooks and a full bills workflow (ingest, approve, pay, void), all under granular OAuth scopes. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity, and the official MCP server is explicitly read-only. Many UI features (invoicing, custom dashboards and reports, Ask Digits tasks, the agentic close workflow, connection setup) have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: documented API parity commitment, API coverage of invoicing, dashboards, custom reports, close workflow and connection management, write-capable agent surface, independent corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
